content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD rainfall module, entire file guarded by preprocessor '# if defined (PRECIPITATION)' (L53, closed L348). MODULE PRECIPITATION_MODULE (L55) uses PARAM, GLOBAL, INPUT_READ (L56-58) and MPI under PARALLEL (L59-62); declares rain-rate arrays PrecRateData1/2, PrecRateData, PrecRateModel (L67-68), bracketing times TimePrec1/TimePrec2 (L70), file names NamePrec1/2 (L71), global index maps IXco/IYco (L72). SUBROUTINE PRECIPITATION_INITIAL (L89-238): reads RainWaveInteraction (L114-115, default .FALSE. L117), OUT_PRECIPITATION (L130, default .TRUE. L132) and mandatory RAINFALL_FILE (L147; missing -> STOP L154/L157) from input.txt (FILE_NAME=INPUT_FILE_NAME L101); opens RAINFALL_FILE on unit 400 (L171-172), reads header title, grid dims M_PrecDim N_PrecDim, first time TimePrec2 and field file NamePrec2 (L175-179), initializes TimePrec1/NamePrec1 to the same (L181-182); allocates rain arrays sized M_PrecDim x N_PrecDim and PrecRateModel(Mloc,Nloc), iXco(Mloc), iYco(Nloc) (L193-197); builds global grid point numbers iXco/iYco: parallel start iista/jjsta at Ibeg/Jbeg (L203, L217), serial start 1 (L207, L220), incremented forward over interior (L209-211, L222-224) and decremented into ghost cells (L212-214, L225-227); reads first rain-rate field from NamePrec2 on unit 401 row-by-row (L230-235). SUBROUTINE PRECIPITATION_DISTRIBUTION (L240-343): when TIME passes both bracket times (L248) shifts level 2 to level 1 (L250-252) and reads next TimePrec2/NamePrec2 from unit 400 (L256-258; on EOF IOstatus<0 GOTO 120 at L257 -> label 120 L300) and next field from unit 401 (L271-275); computes time-interpolation weights tmp2=(TimePrec2-TIME)/MAX(SMALL,ABS(TimePrec2-TimePrec1)), tmp1=1-tmp2 (L289-291; both ZERO before TimePrec1 or when no more data, L280-287); blends PrecRateData = PrecRateData2*tmp1+PrecRateData1*tmp2 (L295); converts mm/hr to m/s multiplying by 0.000000277778 (L298); bilinearly interpolates the M_PrecDim x N_PrecDim data onto the model grid via fractional indices rII,rJJ mapped by global point number over (Mglob-1)/(Nglob-1) (L304-314), then fills last row/column/corner of PrecRateModel by copying neighbors (L316-322). Commented-out per-rank debug dump of PrecRateModel to tmp1..4.txt (L326-340).

equations.ref: linear time blend of rain fields
comment L297 'convert from mm/hr to m/s'

verbatim_spans.text: !  PRECIPITATION is a module to model rainfall effects
120 CONTINUE  ! no more data for vessel Kves

unresolved: L300 label-120 comment says 'no more data for vessel Kves' though this is the precipitation module - text apparently carried over from the vessel module; the GOTO 120 at L257 (EOF on unit 400) is the actual jump source, so after rain schedule EOF the time-blend block L280-298 is skipped and the last PrecRateData is reused without further conversion
PLOT_INTV_PREC and PLOT_COUNT_PREC declared @L74 but never assigned or referenced in this file - the precipitation output interval logic must live elsewhere
RainWaveInteraction read @L114 but not used anywhere else in this file; its physical effect is implemented outside this module
PrecName @L96 and myvar @L82 declared but unused in this file
Interpolation loops run only Ibeg..Iend-1, Jbeg..Jend-1 (L304-305) with edge copy L316-322; ghost regions of PrecRateModel outside Ibeg..Iend/Jbeg..Jend are never filled
Unit number collision risk: unit 400 stays open across calls while unit 401 is opened/closed per field (L254 vs L269); WRITE(3,...) assumes log unit 3 opened elsewhere
L291 'tmp1=1.0_SP - tmp2;' has a trailing semicolon (non-standard Fortran carryover)
OUT_Precipitation (decl @L73) and OUT_PRECIPITATION (@L130,L132) are the same case-insensitive variable; declaration default and read-fallback both .TRUE.
